title: Single finite-level etale descent with a perfect small fibre
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian, d an adic coefficient datum on A, phi_n coefficient isomorphisms, and M a completed derived module [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data]. Assume the finite quotient constant functors preserve zero maps. Fix an X-etale chart V, a point v of V, an index n and integers a <= b. If the actual nth quotient restricted to V has, on a covering etale sieve, constant bounded finite-projective models in [a,b] [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data], then the single-level data type FinitePerfectAdicEtaleLevelData(X,d,phi,M,V,v,n) is inhabited [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-etale-level-data]. There is no assumption on other levels, coefficient-map compatibility, connectedness, compactness or simultaneous trivializations, and no conclusion relating adjacent levels.

source.place: Tag 09C6, construction K_n = epsilon^(-1)L_n and extraction of its perfect fibre; lemma-compare-constructible-derived (Tag 09AL), Tag 09B1; etale-cohomology.tex Tags 03PT and 040R.

proof.text: Convert Q of the termwise constant complex to the exact derived constant realization using its factors isomorphism; the exact ringed restriction agrees with representative-based restriction. Apply the finite-chart origin theorem over the finite quotient B to obtain L and the equivalence of all supplied local constant models.

Choose cover members through each point and recover their etale perfect constant models by reflection. Exact cohomology of constant complexes and finite homology of perfect complexes over finite B give bounded finite locally constant cohomology locally. Coverwise detection of zero and locality of finite local constancy give the global record fields.

Lift the specified algebraic-closure geometric point to a member of the model cover. Pullback-stalk compatibility and the constant-sheaf fibre isomorphism identify its stalk with the lifted Q(P). The supplied finite-projective bounded representative proves Q(P) perfect.

For arbitrary F and a supplied isomorphism on U, pull the constant model to Z using pullback composition. Apply the forward local-model equivalence to the composite Z->U->V. Package all fields in FinitePerfectAdicEtaleLevelData.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePerfectAdic_etale_level_descent
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (V : X.Etale) (v : V.left) (n : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hmodel : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M n V a b) :
    Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicEtaleLevelData X d φ M V v n)
